title: Sqn Ldr Bhawana Kanth — 1st Woman IAF Fighter Combat Leader
summary: At TACDE, Gwalior, after 20-week training; also 1st woman fighter pilot for day-combat missions (2019) & 1st in IAF RD contingent (2021).
